Experience the future of dentistry with cutting-edge innovations designed for comfort and accuracy. Our office features digital scanners, laser dentistry, and 3D imaging that help us plan and perform treatments with remarkable precision.

#### Excellent Patient Service

Every visit is centered around you. From your first consultation to your follow-up care, our compassionate team ensures that your comfort, concerns, and goals guide every step.

## Boca Raton Cosmetic Dentist

At Boca Raton Cosmetic Dentist, we see every smile as a reflection of individuality. Led by expert dental professionals, our team blends artistry, science, and compassion to deliver dentistry that enhances both health and confidence.

For over a decade, our Boca Raton, FL practice has earned the trust of patients throughout South Florida through a commitment to comfort, innovation, and personalized care. Whether you’re visiting for a routine cleaning, a complete smile makeover, or full-mouth rehabilitation, you’ll experience the perfect balance of advanced technology and a gentle, human touch.

Our philosophy is simple: We don’t just treat teeth—we care for people. Every treatment plan is customized to your needs and goals, ensuring you achieve a smile that looks beautiful and feels natural for years to come.

###### meet the Doctor

## Where Experience Meets Compassionate Dentistry

With over 34 years of hands-on experience, Dr. Sasha Winderbaum is known for combining technical precision with a warm, patient-centered approach. A graduate of New York University College of Dentistry, he has placed more than 10,000 crowns and mastered advanced techniques in cosmetic restorations, implant dentistry, and CAD/CAM technology. As one of Florida’s early adopters of digital dentistry, Dr. Winderbaum continues to redefine patient care through innovation, efficiency, and compassion—helping patients achieve lasting, naturally beautiful smiles with confidence and comfort.

Dr. Josefina Vazquez

###### meet the Doctor

## Transforming Smiles Through Passion, Precision, & Purpose

Dr. Josefina Vazquez brings over three decades of global experience to Boca Raton Cosmetic Dentist, blending her background in general dentistry and orthodontics to deliver exceptional, patient-focused care. A graduate of Rutgers School of Dental Medicine and certified Invisalign and Perio Protect provider, she takes pride in helping patients achieve healthy, confident smiles through minimally invasive, modern techniques. Beyond the office, she serves as an assistant professor at Nova Southeastern University College of Dental Medicine and volunteers at the Caridad Center Dental Clinic, where she provides compassionate care to those in need.

###### Our Services

## Comprehensive Care Designed Around You

#### General Dentistry

Preventive care is the foundation of a healthy smile. Our comprehensive exams, cleanings, and screenings help you maintain strong teeth and gums for life.

[Learn More](https://bocaratoncosmeticdentist.com/services/general-dentistry/)

#### Restorative Dentistry

Restore the function and beauty of your smile with precision-crafted fillings, crowns, and bridges. We use modern materials and techniques to deliver natural, lasting results.

[Learn More](https://bocaratoncosmeticdentist.com/services/restorative-dentistry/)

#### Cosmetic Dentistry

From whitening to veneers, our cosmetic treatments enhance your natural beauty with stunning, personalized results. Every detail is designed to boost your confidence and brighten your smile.

[Learn More](https://bocaratoncosmeticdentist.com/services/cosmetic-dentistry/)

#### Dental Crowns

Protect and strengthen damaged teeth with custom-made dental crowns. Crafted with precision, each crown blends seamlessly with your natural smile for beauty and durability.

[Learn More](https://bocaratoncosmeticdentist.com/services/dental-crowns/)

#### Dental Bridges

Replace missing teeth with a secure, natural-looking bridge that restores your bite and confidence. Our bridges are designed to blend beautifully and function comfortably.

[Learn More](https://bocaratoncosmeticdentist.com/services/dental-bridges/)

#### Dental Implants

Experience the gold standard for tooth replacement with dental implants. They look, feel, and function like real teeth—offering stability, comfort, and confidence for years to come.

[Learn More](https://bocaratoncosmeticdentist.com/services/dental-implants/)

#### Orthodontics

Achieve balanced alignment and improved oral health with our comprehensive orthodontic care. We offer solutions tailored to every age and lifestyle for a lifetime of confident smiles.

[Learn More](https://bocaratoncosmeticdentist.com/services/orthodontics/)

#### Full-Mouth Reconstruction

Rebuild and rejuvenate your smile with a customized treatment plan that restores health, aesthetics, and function. Our full-mouth reconstruction services create transformative, lasting results.

[Learn More](https://bocaratoncosmeticdentist.com/services/full-mouth-reconstruction/)

#### Emergency Dentistry

When dental emergencies happen, we’re here to help right away. From broken teeth to sudden pain, our team provides prompt, compassionate care when you need it most.

[Learn More](https://bocaratoncosmeticdentist.com/services/emergency-dentistry/)
